reapack.name: reaper-pad.ext
reapack.desc: reaper-pad: use a USB gamepad as a remote control for REAPER

version.author: MickCh
version.changelog:
First public version.
Added: - REAPER extension that calls the REAPER API directly (Linux and Windows). - Actions: *Reload configuration*, *Enable/disable gamepad*, *Button test (console)*. - Smooth horizontal zoom. - Variable-speed sticks, D-pad auto-repeat, contact-bounce filter. - Rumble on record start/stop and a gentle startup buzz. - Configuration validation with clear error messages. - Unit tests and CI for Linux and Windows.

version.author: MickCh
version.changelog:
Added: - ReaPack repository: install and update reaper-pad from REAPER (`https://github.com/MickCh/reaper-pad/raw/main/index.xml`). - Digital-mode detection for DragonRise pads (Art AG-16T and clones): when the LED is green the right stick presses buttons 1–4, so reaper-pad buzzes three times, prints a warning in the REAPER console and ignores buttons 1–4 until the pad is back in analog mode. Option `detect_digital_mode`.
Changed: - Library files are named by architecture (`reaper_pad-x86_64.so`, `reaper_pad-x64.dll`), like other REAPER extensions. Remove an older manually installed `reaper_pad.so` / `reaper_pad.dll`.
